svg.title: Fluent UI preview: ungrouped component map
svg.desc: Force-directed plot of 90 audited CSS and rendering links, with 78 behavior links in a separate index. No semantic family boxes. All 59 public component entrypoints are represented somewhere in the diagram. Caller composition and proposals are not shown.
svg.text: Fluent UI preview: ungrouped component map
Existing CSS and rendering links drive the layout. Disconnected sets are packed for space, not grouped by purpose.
Reuses CSS or a styling helper

a.xlink:title: AlphaSlider reuses styling from ColorSlider (root, input, rail, thumb CSS)

DrawerHeaderTitle reuses styling from DialogTitle (heading CSS)

Toaster reuses styling from ToastContainer (container layout CSS)
TooltipVisual reuses styling from PopoverSurface (content surface CSS)
